name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2019 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
County Water Authority 75th Anniversary
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 21, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-08-21 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of San Dieguito Water District (SDWD) Resolution 2019-20 amending SDWD Administrative Code Articles 13 relating to Conflict of Interest Code and Filers. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Adopt SDWD Resolution 2019-20 amending SDWD Administrative Code Articles 13 relating to Conflict of Interest Code and Filers.
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S08C Conflict of Interest Code Update
8D.
Notice of Completion for City of Encinitas Tentative Map No. 13-267 Laurel Cove Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S08D Notice of Completion 720 Balour Dr
8E.
Award Construction Contract for the Anode Bed Replacement Project. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Authorize the City Manager in conjunction with the General Counsel to enter into a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 3 with Farwest Corrosion Control Company (Farwest) for the construction of the Anode Bed Replacement Project in the amount of $149,000, plus 15 percent contingency for a total not to exceed amount of $171,350; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-17, creating Project No. CW20K and transferring $171,350 from existing Project No. CW19D to new Project No. CW20K, for tracking purposes.
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S08E Anode Bed Award CW20K
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing for Consideration of Adoption of Resolution No. 2019-19 Implementing Adjustments to the District’s Miscellaneous Fees and Deposit Charges. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to adjustments to the District’s miscellaneous fees and deposit charges; 2) Adopt San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 2019-19, implementing adjustments to the District’s miscellaneous fees and deposits; and 3) Approve requests for revenue adjustments as noted in the Fiscal Considerations section of this report.
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S10A Miscellaneous Fees & Deposit Charges
10B.
Authorization of Joint City and San Dieguito Water District Funding for the Conservation Demonstration Garden at the Public Works Operations Center. Contact Person: Civil Engineer Knoll
Authorize the General Manager to utilize District funding in the amount of $221,500 to construct and install a joint project with the City of Encinitas (City) known as the Conservation Demonstration Garden at the Public Works Operations Center (Demonstration Garden).
2019-09-18 SDWD Item S10B Demonstration Garden
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 23, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
